text:
Central Park Elementary sees 61 sixth-graders take 2024-25 math MCA
D. R. Roland
Sixth-grade students at Central Park Elementary School registered the third highest participation rate for the mathematics portion of the 2024-25 MCA, according to the Minnesota Department of Education.
The school recorded 259 total test-takers for math, with 61 hailing from the sixth grade.
Test standards indicated that 16% of participating sixth-graders were considered proficient in mathematics.
The MCA and Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are state assessments designed to gauge student progress toward Minnesota’s academic standards and to fulfill legislative requirements at both the federal and state level. The tests cover math, reading, and science, depending on the grade. Most pupils participate in the MCA, while those receiving special education services who qualify may instead take the Alt MCA.
Recent data on Minnesota's MCA performance shows lower overall proficiency compared to pre-pandemic numbers, according to Minnesota's Report Card. Statewide math proficiency dropped by over 7% since 2019; reading proficiency decreased by almost 5%.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in mathematics |
|---|---|---|
| 3rd | 77 | 48% |
| 4th | 61 | 34% |
| 5th | 60 | 20% |
| 6th | 61 | 16% |
This article draws on data from the Minnesota Department of Education. Source data can be accessed here.
